# SLIIT Courseweb Cleaner

> Distraction-free Moodle browser extension for SLIIT undergraduates. Automatically filters irrelevant campus announcements, hides completed past-semester modules, and enables eye-friendly dark mode.

SLIIT Courseweb Cleaner is a free, open-source, client-side browser utility built specifically for students at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT). It operates on courseweb.sliit.lk to streamline academic productivity.

## Core Capabilities

- Campus Targeting: Automatically filters noticeboards and activity submission links intended for other campuses (supports Malabe, Metro, Kandy, Kurunegala, Matara, and Jaffna).
- Batch and Group Isolation: Isolates weekday and weekend batch announcements so students only view their relevant groups.
- Side-Panel Drawer Interface: Smooth slide-in preferences drawer anchored above Moodle's back-to-top button for frictionless configuration.
- Zero-Latency Anti-Flash Preloader: Eliminates white flash (FOUC) when navigating between Courseweb pages in dark mode with synchronous theme caching.
- Enhanced Notice Contrast: High-contrast yellow notice containers ensure urgent exam alerts and lab reschedules remain legible in dark mode.
- Ghost Mode (Peek Mode): Fades unassigned modules to 25% opacity so students can still inspect full course offerings at a glance.
- Notice Protector: Built-in safety algorithm guarantees critical university notices, exam timetables, postponement notices, and lab reschedule alerts remain visible.
- Past Semester Cleaner: Hides completed previous semester courses from the dashboard view.
- Eye-Friendly Dark Mode: High-contrast dark theme powered by Dark Reader with screen-blended logo and CSP compliance.
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: Operates entirely offline inside the browser sandbox with zero tracking, zero external telemetry, and zero credentials collection.

## Installation Options

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/sliit-courseweb-cleaner/lnoadlfhebmkhmbfmehdgoffjllgadjm): Official verified extension for Google Chrome, Brave, Arc, and Vivaldi.
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/sliit-courseweb-cleaner/gmlodfhgiopjgamoijjffcmgfenkkkhe): Verified extension for Microsoft Edge.
- [Mozilla Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/sliit-courseweb-cleaner/): Verified AMO add-on for Mozilla Firefox.
- [Userscript Version](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dulithdivisekara/sliit-courseweb-cleaner/main/dist/sliit-courseweb-cleaner.user.js): Standalone userscript for Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey on desktop and mobile browsers.
